part: TP4056 1 A linear Li-ion charger, ESOP-8

datasheet.revision_or_date: REV_2.4 (PDF created 2024-09-02); manufacturer site toppwr.com offers no downloadable PDF

ratings.design: VBUS <= 5.5 V steady; hot-plug peak about 6.7 V
R5 3.3k to GND, regulated about 1 V

ratings.limit: printed '-0.3V~0.7V' (an obvious typo: BAT regulates 4.2 V); true value UNKNOWN
ratings.cite: p2 (verified on the rendered page, not a text-extraction artefact)

ratings.limit: printed as 'EMBED PBrush: -0.3V~10V' (corrupted label, presumably the status pins)
ratings.design: pulled to +3V3 via 100k, also while VCC = 0

ratings.limit: thermal regulation about 145 C (p8) / 140 C (p10) inconsistent in datasheet
ratings.design: about (5-3.0)*0.36 = 0.72 W worst at trickle->CC start

pins.requirement: Charging only while 45%..80% of VCC; grounding TEMP disables the function. Must not float (no default given).
pins.quote: If TEMP pin's voltage is below 45% or above 80% of supply voltage VIN ... charging is suspended.

pins.requirement: RPROG to GND sets IBAT = 1100 V / RPROG (VPROG 1 V in CC); floating PROG = shutdown. Keep RPROG close, low capacitance.
pins.cite: p7 Pin Functions; p9 RPROG table; p11 Manual Shutdown
pins.quote: Charge current is programmed by connecting a resistor RISET from this pin to GND.
pins.issue: R5 3.3k -> 333 mA by 1100/3.3k; datasheet table gives 3k->400 mA, 4k->300 mA (consistent).

pins.requirement: Positive input supply, 4.0..8.0 V operating; bypass close to pin; ceramic input cap: add ~1.5 ohm series resistor against plug-in transients.
pins.cite: p7; p5 VCC row; p13 'CC bypass capacitor'
pins.quote: Adding a 1.5 Ω resistor in series with a ceramic capacitor will minimize start-up voltage transients.
pins.issue: Design uses R41 2.2 ohm + C1 10u (datasheet asks 1.5 ohm; design notes it chose nearest Basic part).

pins.requirement: Connect battery positive; regulates 4.2 V float.
pins.quote: BAT (Pin5): Battery Connection. Connect the positive terminal of the battery to the BAT pin.

pins.requirement: Pulled low when charge complete, else Hi-Z. If unused connect to GND. Sinks 5 mA at <=0.6 V.
pins.cite: p7; p10 'Charge status indicator'; p5 VSTDBY
pins.quote: When battery charge cycle completes, STDBY pin is pulled low by an internal switch, otherwise STDBY pin is high impedance.
pins.issue: Pulled to +3V3 by R9 100k (used, so the 'connect to GND if unused' rule does not apply).

pins.requirement: Pulled low while charging, else Hi-Z (PWM flicker if no battery and TEMP grounded). If unused connect to GND.
pins.quote: When the battery is charging, the CHRG pin is pulled low by an internal switch, otherwise CHRG pin is high impedance.

pins.requirement: Active high enable: high = normal, low = shutdown; TTL/CMOS drivable. Must be driven/pulled (no internal default stated). Logic thresholds NOT given in the datasheet (unknown).
pins.quote: A logic high on CE pin will put the device in normal operation mode. Pulling the CE pin to low will put the TP4056 into shutdown mode.
pins.issue: R43 100k to VBUS (high) + Q4 2N7002 pulls low. CE VIH/VIL unspecified (unknown).

pins.requirement: Must be soldered to PCB ground for thermal performance.
pins.cite: p13 Board Layout Considerations; p14 ESOP8 drawing
pins.quote: requires that the exposed metal pad on the back side of the TP4056 package be soldered to the PC board ground.
pins.footprint_pad: 9 (F.Cu 2.41x3.3 + B.Cu 1.9x2.9 + 6x 0.3 mm vias; 4 F.Paste apertures unnumbered)
pins.issue: EP size in the p14 drawing is a low-resolution raster read as about 3.302 x 2.413 mm (long side along body length); footprint 2.41 x 3.3 mm matches that reading.
